text: Too many popup ads interrupt the experience every time you switch between my tournaments and my matches. It ruins the flow of live scoring.
Paid for the live stream package but the overlay crashed mid match and then they charged extra just to download video highlights. Why separate charges for basic stream tools?
Love the app for grassroots cricket but customer support never replies regarding pro subscription activation issues. Money deducted but account still shows free tier.
Match data got completely wiped due to a sync glitch during an ongoing village tournament. Scorer lost 18 overs of ball-by-ball entries with no offline backup or local recovery.
Can't delete account properly and impossible to undo multiple miskeyed deliveries if the internet drops at the ground. Needs an offline scoring mode with instant local undo.
Great concept but cluttered UI. Full screen video ads between overs cause scorers to miss the first ball of the next over while trying to close the ad.
Grassroots tournament organizers need a clean scoring app that doesn't nickel and dime you for live streaming overlays or hide basic player statistics behind expensive paywalls.
Double billing on yearly renewal with zero support response. Cancelling subscription through the app is deliberately complicated.
Heavy battery drain and overheating during hot afternoon matches on the ground due to constant ad tracking and background bloat.
Uninstalled after years of using it because every basic feature like opponent scouting, wagon wheel charts, and team compare is now behind CricHeroes Pro paywall.
